notes: *of good men* heads on *good*: *men* is the generic the ASV supplies to complete the substantival adjective and is never the head (rules 31 and 46), while the *of* is the chain's own relation on the rectum (rule 19).
*of the righteous* divides the same way, the supplied *the* joining the anarthrous substantive's unit (rule 46).
The second colon's verb takes the bare *keep*, coordinated under the modal frame of the first colon (rule 17).
